1.english_reference: Josiah [ was ] eight years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִ֖ים יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְ מָלְכ֑ וֹ

traditions.VUL: Octo annórum erat Iosías cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Josiah [ was ] eight years old when he began to reign ,

1.english_reference: and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְ אַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τριάκοντα ἓν ἔτος ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: et trigínta et uno anno regnávit in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years .

2.english_reference: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐναντίον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Fecítque quod erat rectum in conspéctu Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD ,

2.english_reference: and walked in the ways of David his father

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ דַרְכֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδοῖς Δαυεὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et ambulávit in viis David patris sui :
traditions.KJV: and walked in the ways of David his father ,

2.english_reference: and declined [ neither ] to the right hand , nor to the left

traditions.WLC: ו וְ לֹא סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּ שְׂמֹֽאול
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐξέκλινεν δεξιὰ καὶ ἀριστερά .
traditions.VUL: non declinávit neque ad dextram , neque ad sinístram .
traditions.KJV: and declined [ neither ] to the right hand , nor to the left .

3.english_reference: For in the eighth year of his reign , while he was yet young , he began to seek after the God of David his father

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ שְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה שָׁנִ֜ים לְ מָלְכ֗ וֹ וְ הוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣ נּוּ נַ֔עַר הֵחֵ֕ל לִ דְר֕וֹשׁ לֵ אלֹהֵ֖י דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀγδόῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ , καὶ αὐτὸς ἔτι παιδάριον , ἤρξατο τοῦ ζητῆσαι Κύριον τὸν θεὸν Δαυεὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Octávo autem anno regni sui , cum adhuc esset puer , cœpit quǽrere Deum patris sui David :
traditions.KJV: For in the eighth year of his reign , while he was yet young , he began to seek after the God of David his father :

3.english_reference: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places , and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images

traditions.WLC: ו וּ בִ שְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה הֵחֵל֙ לְ טַהֵ֔ר אֶת יְהוּדָה֙ וִ יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִן הַ בָּמוֹת֙ וְ הָ֣ אֲשֵׁרִ֔ים וְ הַ פְּסִלִ֖ים וְ הַ מַּסֵּכֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ δωδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ ἤρξατο τοῦ καθαρίσαι τὸν Ἰουδὰ καὶ τὴν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἀπὸ τῶν ὑψηλῶν καὶ τῶν ἄλσεων , καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν χωνευτῶν ·

traditions.KJV: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places , and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images .

4.english_reference: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence

traditions.WLC: וַ יְנַתְּצ֣וּ לְ פָנָ֗י ו אֵ֚ת מִזְבְּח֣וֹת הַ בְּעָלִ֔ים

traditions.KJV: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence ;

4.english_reference: and the images , that [ were ] on high above them , he cut down

traditions.WLC: וְ הַֽ חַמָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר לְ מַ֥עְלָ ה מֵ עֲלֵי הֶ֖ם גִּדֵּ֑עַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ τὰ ἐπ᾽ αὐτῶν , καὶ ἔκοψεν
traditions.VUL: et simulácra , quæ superpósita fúerant , demolíti sunt :
traditions.KJV: and the images , that [ were ] on high above them , he cut down ;

4.english_reference: and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust [ of them ]

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ הָ אֲשֵׁרִים וְ הַ פְּסִלִ֤ים וְ הַ מַּסֵּכוֹת֙ שִׁבַּ֣ר וְ הֵדַ֔ק
traditions.LXX: τὰ ἄλση καὶ τὰ γλυπτά , καὶ τὰ χωνευτά συνέτριψεν καὶ ἐλέπτυνεν
traditions.VUL: lucos étiam et sculptília succídit atque commínuit :
traditions.KJV: and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust [ of them ] ,

4.english_reference: and strowed [ it ] upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּזְרֹק֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ קְּבָרִ֔ים הַ זֹּבְחִ֖ים לָ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔρριψεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τῶν μνημάτων τῶν θυσιαζόντων αὐτοῖς ·
traditions.VUL: et super túmulos eórum , qui eis immoláre consuéverant , fragménta dispérsit .
traditions.KJV: and strowed [ it ] upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them .

5.english_reference: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars

traditions.WLC: וְ עַצְמוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שָׂרַ֖ף עַל מזבחותים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὀστᾶ ἱερέων κατέκαυσεν ἐπὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια ,
traditions.VUL: Ossa prætérea sacerdótum combússit in altáribus idolórum ,
traditions.KJV: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְטַהֵ֥ר אֶת יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκαθάρισεν τὸν Ἰουδὰ καὶ τὴν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: mundavítque Iudam et Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem .

6.english_reference: And [ so did he ] in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ עָרֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה וְ אֶפְרַ֛יִם וְ שִׁמְע֖וֹן וְ עַד נַפְתָּלִ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν Ἐφράιμ καὶ Μανασσὴ καὶ Συμεὼν καὶ Νεφθαλεὶ
traditions.VUL: Sed et in úrbibus Manásse , et Ephraim , et Símeon , usque Néphthali ,
traditions.KJV: And [ so did he ] in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali ,

traditions.WLC: ב הר בתי הם סָבִֽיב
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς τόποις αὐτῶν κύκλῳ .
traditions.VUL: cuncta subvértit .
traditions.KJV: with their mattocks round about .

7.english_reference: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves

traditions.WLC: וַ יְנַתֵּ֣ץ אֶת הַֽ מִּזְבְּח֗וֹת וְ אֶת הָ אֲשֵׁרִ֤ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέσπασεν τὰ ἄλση καὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque altária dissipásset , et lucos ,
traditions.KJV: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves ,

7.english_reference: and had beaten the graven images into powder

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ פְּסִלִים֙ כִּתַּ֣ת לְ הֵדַ֔ק
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα κατέκοψεν λεπτά ,
traditions.VUL: et sculptília contrivísset in frusta ,
traditions.KJV: and had beaten the graven images into powder ,

7.english_reference: and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל הַֽ חַמָּנִ֥ים גִּדַּ֖ע בְּ כָל אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντα τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἔκοψεν ἀπὸ πάσης τῆς γῆς Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: cunctáque delúbra demolítus esset de univérsa terra Israel ,
traditions.KJV: and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֖שָׁב לִ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: ἀπέστρεψεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: revérsus est in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: he returned to Jerusalem .

8.english_reference: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ לְ מָלְכ֔ וֹ לְ טַהֵ֥ר הָ אָ֖רֶץ וְ הַ בָּ֑יִת
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ , τοῦ καθαρίσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὸν οἶκον , [ ἀπέστειλεν ]
traditions.VUL: Igitur anno octávo décimo regni sui , mundáta iam terra , et templo Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house ,

8.english_reference: he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder

traditions.WLC: שָׁ֠לַח אֶת שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן אֲצַלְיָ֜הוּ וְ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣הוּ שַׂר הָ עִ֗יר וְ֠ אֵת יוֹאָ֤ח בֶּן יֽוֹאָחָז֙ הַ מַּזְכִּ֔יר
traditions.LXX: Σαφὰν υἱὸν Σελιὰ καὶ τὸν Μαασὰ ἄρχοντα τῆς πόλεως καὶ τὸν Ἰουὰχ υἱὸν Ἰωὰχ τὸν ὑπομνηματογράφον αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: misit Saphan fílium Eselíæ , et Maasíam príncipem civitátis , et Ioha fílium Ióachaz a commentáriis ,
traditions.KJV: he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder ,

8.english_reference: to repair the house of the LORD his God

traditions.WLC: לְ חַזֵּ֕ק אֶת בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: κραταιῶσαι τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: ut instaurárent domum Dómini Dei sui .
traditions.KJV: to repair the house of the LORD his God .

9.english_reference: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ גָּד֗וֹל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς Χελκείαν τὸν ἱερέα τὸν μέγαν ,

traditions.KJV: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנוּ֮ אֶת הַ כֶּסֶף֮ הַ מּוּבָ֣א בֵית אֱלֹהִים֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εἰσενεχθὲν εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: acceptámque ab eo pecúniam , quæ illáta fúerat in domum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God ,

9.english_reference: which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim , and of all the remnant of Israel , and of all Judah and Benjamin

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָסְפֽוּ הַ לְוִיִּם֩ שֹׁמְרֵ֨י הַ סַּ֜ף מִ יַּ֧ד מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְ אֶפְרַ֗יִם וּ מִ כֹּל֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ מִ כָּל יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ בִנְיָמִ֑ן
traditions.LXX: ὃ συνήγαγον οἱ Λευεῖται φυλάσσοντες τὴν πύλην ἐκ χειρὸς Μανασσὴ καὶ Ἐφράιμ καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ ἀπὸ παντὸς καταλοίπου ἐν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ υἱῶν Ἰούδα καὶ Βενιαμεὶν

traditions.VUL: et habitatóribus Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: and they returned to Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנ֨וּ אֹת֜ וֹ עוֹשֵׂ֣י הַ מְּלָאכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ בְּ בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לִ בְדּ֥וֹק וּ לְ חַזֵּ֖ק הַ בָּֽיִת

11.english_reference: Even to the artificers and builders gave they [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנ֗וּ לֶ חָֽרָשִׁים֙ וְ לַ בֹּנִ֔ים

traditions.KJV: Even to the artificers and builders gave they [ it ] ,

traditions.KJV: to buy hewn stone , and timber for couplings ,

traditions.KJV: and [ other of ] the Levites , all that could skill of instruments of musick .
